notes.title: Wooden Tools Update
notes.content:
[h2]Crafting Branch and Wooden Tools[/h2]

You can get a wooden board by combining 3 branches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474068/dbfec86f36507ddf74d7cb3b0cb98a99c697a40c.png[/img]
You can also create new wooden tools using wooden boards.



[h2]Give Jissouseki a weapon and a armor![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474068/0b69fd4aca3c9a97369f92b5226fdc5fe481852f.png[/img]
You can now put equipment on Jissouseki.

For now, only wooden tools obtained by combining wooden boards are available.



[h2]Add Weapon and Armor Dictionary[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474068/138ab85c81a91143a7ddf0b65d39b720d3215344.png[/img]
New items have been added in Dictionary.

notes.title: New Enemy Update
notes.content:
[h2]New Enemy: Baldity (Bald + Nudity)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474068/222e3d2157c018f2103a2aa4a170c23d86b080fe.png[/img]
A new enemy character, Baldity, appears with 20% chance of moving to the battle field.

Baldity has higher HP, ATK, and AGI than Wild Jissouseki.
Instead, it drops three times more EXP and Money.


[h2]Bug fix[/h2]

Wild Jissouseki's Sprite fixed a bug that used the Adult Jissouseki's Sprite.

Thank you for playing Jissou Land!

notes.title: Winter is coming!
notes.content:
[h2]The season when everything freezes is coming...[/h2]

[b]Jissouseki needs more updates to stay safe in the winter, right?[/b]


[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474068/b281c41f1209bcff2d4eb0f69f9d090099ec91bc.png[/img]
[h3]1. It snowed in the park![/h3]
Enjoy the new-looking park.

[h3]2. The limit on item possession has been extended to 500 units.[/h3]
You can now have more items at the same time.

[h3]3. You can feed Jissouseki food to restore HP.[/h3]
Don't let the experienced Jissouseki die!

[h3]4. If Jissouseki levels up, he recovers all SPs.[/h3]
The action that consumes SP will be developed.

[h3]5. Living Wild Jissouseki[/h3]
Now the Wild Jissousekis in the battle breathe!

[h3]6. Added background to battle screen.[/h3]
Even during the battle, you can see the snowy park.

[h3]7. The description on the store page has been updated.[/h3]


[h2]Lastly...[/h2]

It is not enough for Jissouseki to have a warm winter.

Please look forward to more updates!

notes.title: Battle Update
notes.content:
The battle system has been updated.

If you have more than one Adult Jissouseki, you can select Jissouseki to add it as a party member.

If the party has an Jissouseki, you can click the sign to move it to a new field.

If you enter the new field, you can fight Wild Jissouseki.

If you win the battle, you get EXP, Maggots (Money), and Items.

Wild Jissouseki drops Jissou Coin, Branch, and Stone as probability.

If you die in battle or lose the battle, that Jissouseki is excluded from the party.

In addition, 2 new achievements related to this update have been added.

Have a great time at Jissou Land!

[i][b]ADD: If you get an error opening the menu after pick a member, you will need to restart the game from scratch. I'm sorry for the inconvenience.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Lag Prevention Update
notes.content:
[h3]Automatic Conversion Function[/h3]

Jissouseki, which has increased significantly during the game, is causing the lag, so instead of creating a new object when the number of objects reaches a certain amount, we modified it to automatically convert it into an item.

If there are more than 20 Ujicha's in the field, the new Ujicha's are automatically converted to 1 Money(maggot).

If there are more than 10 Child Jissouseki's in the field, the new Child's are automatically converted to 2 food.

If there are more than 6 Adult Jissouseki's in the field, the new Adult's are automatically converted to 1 Piece of Stone.


[h3]New Items[/h3]

Stone, Piece of Stone were added.

If you collect 4 pieces of stone, you can make 1 stone.

Stone is a new special currency that distinguishes it from money(maggot).

We don't have a place to use it at the moment, but we're going to add it in the future.


[h3]Preparing for Battle Update[/h3]

The battle system is in the final stage.

If you get rid of Jissouseki, you can get a stone with a low probability.

I will try to hurry up and introduce new content. Thank you.

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content:
We received a request for Achievements and proceeded with the update.

You can now unlock 5 new achievements!

Future updates will add more achievements to new content.

If you have any comments on the game, please visit the discussion page and let us know!

Thank you.

notes.title: Jissou Land Early Access Launch
notes.content:
Hello there!

Jissou Land was released today as Early Access.

Jissou Land currently has only very basic clicker features.

We will continue to make efforts to provide more fun games to users through continuous updates.

However, please understand that the update cycle may not be constant.

If you want to support the development, it would be very helpful if you could purchase the Donation DLCs.



[h2]What to Update[/h2]

[h3]Battle System[/h3]

You can send Jissouseki to fight against other external Jissouseki.

Jissouseki, who has gained experience through battle, becomes stronger.

You can use the items obtained from other Jissouseki.

[h3]New currencies and entertainment[/h3]

You can invest Ujicha in Jissou Coin to make a fortune.

You can visit Jissou Casino and enjoy simple mini games.

Acquire casinos and make regular profits.



[h2]Recruitment of feedback[/h2]

Jissou Land is waiting for your feedback!

Please leave your comments on the forum or game review.

Any comments, bug reports, improvements, idea recommendations, etc. would be great.

Of course, I can't accept all the requests I received, but Jissou Land always has all the possibilities in mind.

I'll be waiting for your review.

Thank you.
